hero.title: Real-World Results, Accelerated Timelines
hero.description: Discover how developers and investors leverage SiteSynergy to de-risk projects and find optimal sites faster than ever before.

pioneer.title: Project Helios: 150MW Utility-Scale Solar in West Texas
pioneer.challenge: Pioneer Solar needed to identify a utility-scale solar site with high GHI, proximity to interconnection points, and minimal environmental impact, all within a compressed 3-month deadline to meet funding requirements.
pioneer.solution: Using the SiteSynergy platform, we analyzed over 500,000 acres, applying dozens of layers including grid capacity, protected lands, slope analysis, and advanced financial modeling to score and rank the most promising parcels automatically.

veridian.title: Project Northwind: 200MW Wind Farm in the Midwest
veridian.challenge: Veridian faced the immense task of screening a multi-county area in Iowa for a greenfield wind project, needing to balance optimal wind speeds with complex environmental setbacks, turbine accessibility, and grid capacity.
veridian.solution: Our platform ingested and processed terabytes of wind resource data alongside environmental, logistical, and grid constraint layers. This allowed for a rapid, multi-faceted analysis that would have taken a team of GIS analysts half a year to complete.

empire.title: Hudson Valley Initiative: 25MW Community Solar
empire.challenge: A community solar co-op needed to find a suitable 100-200 acre parcel in a region with strict zoning laws, high land costs, and vocal community stakeholders. They had previously spent 6 months manually reviewing sites with no success.
empire.solution: SiteSynergy focused the search by first filtering for parcels that met the complex zoning and setback requirements. We then layered on economic and grid data to find the few sites that were not only compliant but also financially viable.
